campaigns_event_name_chk.name: campaigns_event_name_chk
campaigns_event_name_chk.value: "campaigns"."event_name" IS NULL OR char_length("campaigns"."event_name") BETWEEN 2 AND 120

campaigns_closed_chk.name: campaigns_closed_chk
campaigns_closed_chk.value: ("campaigns"."status" = 'closed') = ("campaigns"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("campaigns"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("campaigns"."closed_by" IS NULL)

itinerary_items_schedule_chk.name: itinerary_items_schedule_chk
itinerary_items_schedule_chk.value: ("itinerary_items"."start_time" IS NULL OR "itinerary_items"."start_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."end_time" IS NULL OR "itinerary_items"."end_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."start_time" IS NULL) = ("itinerary_items"."start_time_zone" IS NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."end_time" IS NULL) = ("itinerary_items"."end_time_zone" IS NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."end_date" IS NULL OR ("itinerary_items"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "itinerary_items"."end_date" >= "itinerary_items"."start_date"))

lead_activities_body_chk.name: lead_activities_body_chk
lead_activities_body_chk.value: ("lead_activities"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("lead_activities"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000) AND CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" IN ('note', 'call', 'message') THEN "lead_activities"."body" IS NOT NULL WHEN "lead_activities"."type" IN ('automation', 're_registered') THEN "lead_activities"."body" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("lead_activities"."body") <= 500 WHEN "lead_activities"."type" IN ('created', 'stage_changed') THEN true ELSE "lead_activities"."body" IS NULL END

lead_activities_stage_chk.name: lead_activities_stage_chk
lead_activities_stage_chk.value: CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" = 'stage_changed' THEN "lead_activities"."stage_from" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."stage_to" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."stage_from" <> "lead_activities"."stage_to" ELSE "lead_activities"."stage_from" IS NULL AND "lead_activities"."stage_to" IS NULL END

lead_activities_owner_chk.name: lead_activities_owner_chk
lead_activities_owner_chk.value: CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" = 'owner_changed' THEN "lead_activities"."owner_to" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."owner_from" IS DISTINCT FROM "lead_activities"."owner_to" ELSE "lead_activities"."owner_from" IS NULL AND "lead_activities"."owner_to" IS NULL END

lead_activities_channel_chk.name: lead_activities_channel_chk
lead_activities_channel_chk.value: CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" = 'channel_changed' THEN "lead_activities"."channel_from" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."channel_to" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."channel_from" <> "lead_activities"."channel_to" ELSE "lead_activities"."channel_from" IS NULL AND "lead_activities"."channel_to" IS NULL END

leads_email_chk.name: leads_email_chk
leads_email_chk.value: "leads"."email" IS NULL OR ("leads"."email" = lower("leads"."email") AND char_length("leads"."email") <= 254)

leads_lost_reason_chk.name: leads_lost_reason_chk
leads_lost_reason_chk.value: ("leads"."stage" = 'lost') = ("leads"."lost_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leads"."lost_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."lost_reason") <= 200)

leads_next_action_chk.name: leads_next_action_chk
leads_next_action_chk.value: ("leads"."next_action_note" IS NULL OR ("leads"."next_action_date" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("leads"."next_action_note") <= 200)) AND ("leads"."next_action_date" IS NULL OR ("leads"."stage" NOT IN ('paid', 'lost') AND "leads"."archived_at" IS NULL))

leads_origin_detail_chk.name: leads_origin_detail_chk
leads_origin_detail_chk.value: "leads"."origin_detail" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."origin_detail") BETWEEN 2 AND 120

leads_utm_chk.name: leads_utm_chk
leads_utm_chk.value: ("leads"."utm_source" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."utm_source") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("leads"."utm_medium" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."utm_medium") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("leads"."utm_campaign" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."utm_campaign") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

leads_referred_by_chk.name: leads_referred_by_chk
leads_referred_by_chk.value: "leads"."referred_by" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."referred_by") BETWEEN 2 AND 120

leads_submission_chk.name: leads_submission_chk
leads_submission_chk.value: ("leads"."idempotency_key" IS NULL) = ("leads"."submission_hash" IS NULL) AND ("leads"."submission_hash" IS NULL OR "leads"."submission_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

outbox_events_lease_chk.name: outbox_events_lease_chk
outbox_events_lease_chk.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processing') = ("outbox_events"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL) AND ("outbox_events"."lease_token" IS NULL) = ("outbox_events"."lease_until" IS NULL)

outbox_events_dedupe_key_chk.name: outbox_events_dedupe_key_chk
outbox_events_dedupe_key_chk.value: ("outbox_events"."dedupe_key" IS NULL OR char_length("outbox_events"."dedupe_key") BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("outbox_events"."type" <> 'lead.follow_up_due' OR "outbox_events"."dedupe_key" IS NOT NULL)

trip_offers_deposits_chk.name: trip_offers_deposits_chk
trip_offers_deposits_chk.value: cardinality("trip_offers"."deposit_options_usd") <= 3 AND array_position("trip_offers"."deposit_options_usd", NULL) IS NULL AND 0 < ALL ("trip_offers"."deposit_options_usd") AND ("trip_offers"."total_price_usd" - "trip_offers"."discount_usd") > ALL ("trip_offers"."deposit_options_usd")

trip_offers_approved_chk.name: trip_offers_approved_chk
trip_offers_approved_chk.value: ("trip_offers"."approved_at" IS NULL) = ("trip_offers"."approved_by" IS NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."status" <> 'draft' OR "trip_offers"."approved_at" IS NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'active') OR "trip_offers"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

trip_offers_activated_chk.name: trip_offers_activated_chk
trip_offers_activated_chk.value: ("trip_offers"."activated_at" IS NULL) = ("trip_offers"."activated_by" IS NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."activated_at" IS NULL OR "trip_offers"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."status" <> 'active' OR "trip_offers"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."status" NOT IN ('draft', 'approved') OR "trip_offers"."activated_at" IS NULL)

trip_offers_closed_chk.name: trip_offers_closed_chk
trip_offers_closed_chk.value: ("trip_offers"."status" = 'closed') = ("trip_offers"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("trip_offers"."closed_by" IS NULL) AND ("trip_offers"."superseded_by" IS NULL OR ("trip_offers"."status" = 'closed' AND "trip_offers"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL))

trips_travel_dates_chk.name: trips_travel_dates_chk
trips_travel_dates_chk.value: ("trips"."start_date" IS NULL) = ("trips"."end_date" IS NULL) AND ("trips"."start_date" IS NULL OR ("trips"."start_date" <= "trips"."race_date" AND "trips"."race_date" <= "trips"."end_date"))
